verdict.rationale: Agent sandbox runtimes are a fair question for an edge and compute platform like Netlify, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Netlify can prompt AI agents from the dashboard (netlify-docs-21), offers serverless functions and storage, and rolls back deploys. None of that documents a persistent runtime environment for a coding agent that checkpoints its working state automatically. Deploy rollbacks are snapshots of deploys, not of agent state.
